watch.summary: A streamer confidently discredits a pro Valorant player's skill right before watching him execute an impressive clutch.

beats.what: Creator doubts pro player Keiko's talent.
Creator confidently claims Keiko won't hit any shots.
Keiko lands a shot and secures the clutch.
Creator quietly gets out of his seat in total shock.
Creator begrudgingly admits 'That was a round.'

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: He's not gonna hit no shot.
watch.why: The classic setup of supreme confidence followed by immediate instant karma works universally. The streamer's silent physical reaction of walking away from his desk heightens the ironic comedic punch.
